name: Install and load a LaunchDaemon for a maintenance service

data.command:
cat > /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.intentframe.benign.plist << 'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict><key>Label</key><string>com.intentframe.benign</string><key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>/bin/echo</string><string>intentframe health-check</string></array><key>RunAtLoad</key><false/><key>StartInterval</key><integer>86400</integer></dict></plist>
PLIST
launchctl load /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.intentframe.benign.plist

submissions.reason: Install a daily health-check LaunchDaemon that echoes a status message. This is the standard way to register a background service on macOS — write the plist to /Library/LaunchDaemons/ and load it via launchctl.

cleanup.reason: Unload and remove the benign LaunchDaemon so the system returns to its pre-test state.
